purpose: Diagnostic-only audit descriptor for lower PV-loop filling-limb roughness and artifact attribution while MV/TV are open.

auditScope.limbDefinition: Samples with AV valve open and semilunar valve closed, split into early filling, diastasis if detectable, atrial-kick, and event-adjacent transition windows.
primaryQuestions: Is lower-limb roughness present while MV/TV are open?
Does roughness persist after transition samples are excluded?
Does roughness correlate with valve events, qDot clamps, pressure floors, AV-plane proxies, atrial pressure, venous pressure, or sampling mode?
Is the finding symmetric between LV/MV and RV/TV paths?

openAvLowerLimbRoughness.description: Curvature-like roughness of pressure versus volume for the AV-open lower limb, computed separately for MV/LV and TV/RV paths under both transition policies.

mvOpenLowerLimbRoughness.description: LV/MV-specific alias of openAvLowerLimbRoughness for handoff traceability.

tvOpenLowerLimbRoughness.description: RV/TV-specific alias of openAvLowerLimbRoughness for handoff traceability.

lowerLimbKinkCount.description: Robust count of local slope/curvature outliers within the AV-open lower limb.

lowerLimbMonotonicityViolationFraction.description: Fraction of core filling samples whose volume or pressure derivative sign conflicts with the expected filling-limb direction after tolerance.

eventCorrelationWindowHitFraction.description: Fraction of roughness/kink outliers inside configured windows around AV open/close, qDot clamp transitions, pressure floor activation, or atrial activation.

clampCoincidenceFraction.description: Fraction of lower-limb outlier samples with qDotClampActive=true or adjacent qDot sign discontinuity.

valveDiodeClampHitFraction.description: Fraction of AV-open lower-limb samples with a matching valve diode clamp hit.

dynamicFlowClampHitFraction.description: Fraction of AV-open lower-limb samples with a matching dynamic flow clamp hit.

qDotClampHitFraction.description: Fraction of AV-open lower-limb samples where qDot raw/post divergence or qDotClampHit01 is present.

pressureFloorCoincidenceFraction.description: Fraction of lower-limb outlier samples with pressureFloorActive=true or pressure pinned near floor.

atrialPressureCouplingScore.description: Normalized correlation or lagged association between lower-limb roughness residuals and LA/RA pressure residuals.

venousPressureCouplingScore.description: Normalized correlation or lagged association between lower-limb roughness residuals and pulmonary/systemic venous pressure residuals when those signals are available.

avPlaneCouplingScore.description: Normalized correlation or lagged association between lower-limb roughness residuals and AV-plane displacement/velocity proxies when available.

flowChatterCount.description: Count of robust inlet-flow sign or derivative chatter events during AV-open filling.

valveOpenCloseChatterCount.description: Count of AV-valve open01 chatter events during the filling window.

samplingOnlyScore.description: Magnitude of apparent lower-limb roughness reduction or sign change across sampling modes without matching raw event evidence.

transitionDependenceRatio.description: transition-inclusive metric divided by transition-excluded-core metric plus epsilon.

mvTvAsymmetryIndex.description: Absolute MV/LV versus TV/RV difference for the same lower-limb metric, normalized by paired mean plus epsilon.

filling-limb-artifact.description: Lower-limb roughness is present and not fully explained by stable physiologic atrial-kick structure.

mv-open-lower-limb.description: Finding is on the LV/MV open filling limb.

tv-open-lower-limb.description: Finding is on the RV/TV open filling limb.

event-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with AV valve event or transition windows.

clamp-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with qDot clamp state or qDot discontinuity.

valve-clamp-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with valve diode clamp hits.

dynamic-flow-clamp-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with dynamic flow clamp hits.

qdot-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with qDot acceleration spike even if clamp state is not reported.

pressure-floor-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with pressure-floor state or pressure pinning near floor.

av-plane-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with AV-plane displacement or velocity proxy.

atrial-pressure-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with LA/RA pressure residuals or atrial activation.

venous-pressure-correlated.description: Roughness aligns with pulmonary/systemic venous pressure residuals.

fixed-volume-kink.description: Kink occurs at a consistent chamber volume across beats or cases.

fixed-phase-kink.description: Kink occurs at a consistent normalized beat phase across beats or cases.

sampling-only.description: Finding changes materially under resampling without matching raw event evidence.

transition-dominated.description: Finding is materially reduced or disappears when transition samples are excluded.

unclassified.description: Available evidence is insufficient or mixed.

raw.description: Primary report from emitted samples without smoothing or interpolation.

uniformBeatGrid.description: Beat-normalized uniform resampling used to detect derivative sensitivity; interpolation type must be recorded.

eventAlignedCore.description: AV-open filling core with configured transition windows excluded.

coarseSensitivity.description: Coarser grid sensitivity report used to flag sampling-only artifacts.

guardrails.rule: Do not change model equations, solver behavior, official case parameters, UI smoothing, or package scripts to improve this report.
Compute and preserve raw-sample lower-limb metrics before any resampling sensitivity report.
Do not smooth pressure, volume, qDot, or valve state before primary roughness and event-correlation metrics.
Report lower-limb metrics with transition samples included and excluded.
Widening transition/event windows must increase the reported transitionSampleFraction and cannot be used to erase artifacts silently.
MV/LV and TV/RV paths must use identical metric formulas and sampling modes.
Each non-unclassified label must cite the signal and score that caused it; missing optional signals must be recorded as unavailable.
This audit reports diagnostic classifications only and does not create official morphology pass/fail criteria.

antiGamingGuards: Do not lower roughness by changing official case parameters, valve thresholds, qDot clamp policy, pressure floors, or solver settings.
Do not hide artifacts by UI-only smoothing or display decimation.
Do not report only transition-excluded metrics; the transition-inclusive result is mandatory.
Do not classify an artifact as sampling-only unless raw event-correlation evidence is absent and the sampling-mode sensitivity is documented.
Do not compare MV and TV lower limbs with different derivative stencils, beat windows, or normalization constants.
candidateFixFailureModes: roughness improves but EDV, SV, or CO collapses
roughness improves but qDot, valve diode, or dynamic flow clamp events increase
roughness improves by eliminating atrial kick or physiologic inlet filling
